details: The published OpenAPI 3.1.0 contract retains the OpenAPI 3.0 file declaration type:string/format:binary. The validator consequently rejects multipart file bytes as not a string. In the same current official contract, the Python x-codeSamples for this operation uses open(..., rb) and requests.post(..., files=data), and its multipart encoding explicitly permits image/png, image/jpeg and application/pdf. The node sends exactly that raw multipart file, with documented form fields; converting file contents to text/base64 to satisfy the legacy schema would contradict the provider example. Published source bytes match the pinned SHA-256.
